shared_elements: low-relief carving with incised linear detail
circular/spiral motif (disc on A, coiled horn on B)
justification: The only correspondence is generic: both surfaces bear relief carving with incised linear detail and contain circular forms (a plain disc on A, the coiled horns of B), which any tradition could produce independently. A depicts a single frontal anthropomorphic figure with schematic torso motifs and bands, while B depicts a pair of overlapping profile horned quadrupeds with fleece rendered as dense rows of curls — different subjects, relationships and rendering conventions entirely.
